description:
Show one or all apartments with photos as an interactive gallery card in the chat.

Use instead of get_apartment_details when the guest wants to see the apartments (one apartment: up to 3
swipeable photos; all: one photo each, with buttons to check availability or open the page). Same
arguments, behaviour (read-only, no prices) and result as get_apartment_details, plus photos.

language.description: Answer language: 'de' (default) or 'en' — use the language of the conversation. Text and card are always in the same language.
language.title: Language

name.description: Apartment number such as '12' or '#16'; empty or 'all' = all online-bookable apartments; '17' = Studio #17 (on request only)
name.title: Name

name: render_apartment_gallery

on_request.description: True = not bookable online, enquiry only

url.description: Apartment page, or the enquiry form for on-request apartments

title: Show Apartment Gallery
